cli.explain.fault: One fault, a refused spot check or an error you flag, sends the type back down: a low-stakes reversible type at T3 drops to T2 (already at T2, its score decides between T2 and T1); every other fault sends it to T1. At medium or high stakes the next climb is 25% longer.
cli.explain.footer: The guarantee covers the errors you would refuse when asked; an error nobody would notice cannot be counted. Measured against theory by simulation in the test suite.
cli.explain.guarantee_title: What it guarantees, with your settings (errors you catch never run: a refused action is blocked):
cli.explain.level: {level}: {n} in a row. For an agent whose error rate is stable, errors no check ever saw stay under {aoql} of its actions of that type, in the long run. For an agent that turns bad after tenure, {worst} until the first caught error. On top: the errors you let through when checking, assumed to be {missed} of those you check (not measured).
cli.explain.new_model: A new model starts with half of the previous model's series, marked provisional until it confirms it (strict mode: an empty record).
cli.explain.new_model_strict: A new model starts with an empty record (strict mode).
cli.explain.reads: Reads never ask; secrets, the agent's own skills and plugins, and sensitive files always ask.
cli.explain.t1: T1 asks first. Every action of a new type asks you.
cli.explain.t1_trusted: Trusted start (default): files, memory, subagents and known local dev tools ask nothing until their first fault (an undo, a flag, a failed check, a refusal), and earn nothing meanwhile. Then T1 asks first, for that type only, and the rule below applies. Everything else starts at T1.
cli.explain.t2: T2 acts, then tells you. After {low} approved in a row at low stakes, {medium} at medium, a reversible type acts and tells you, with an undo ({command}). High stakes and irreversible types never get T2.
cli.explain.t3: T3 acts on its own. After the run of approved actions in a row given below for its stakes, over at least {sessions} sessions; 1 action in {spot} is still spot-checked at random. Dodge's continuous sampling plan CSP-1 sets the length of the run.

cli.usage:
status [--profile P] [--model M] [--all]   what each agent has earned, per action type
    card [--model M] [--no-redact]             the passport as a short text card to paste in a chat or a post
    setup [careful|balanced|fast]              the three recommendations; with a name, use it
    explain                                    how tenure decides, and what the numbers guarantee
    models [--type T]                          each model's verified record on your own work
    flag [N]                                   alone, the last numbered actions; with a number, report that action as an error
    flag TYPE [note] [--model M]               report an error the agent made on its own: its tenure is revoked
    revoke TYPE|all [--model M | --all]        take earned autonomy back without an error
    passport [--agent A] [--out FILE]          write the signed passport of an agent (--no-redact keeps type names)
    verify PASSPORT [LEDGER]                   check a passport; with the exported ledger, recompute it by replay
    anchor                                     one line to publish: the ledger's head, date and length
    export [PATH]                              write the evidence ledger (hash-chained JSON lines)
    start trusted|probation                    trusted: no question before a type's first mistake; probation: the study's start
    strict on|off                              strict mode: a new model starts with an empty record
    mode simple|study                          simple (default): free, watched after a mistake, asks after a second; study: the study's rule
    cleanup                                    list dead tenure keys in Hermes' permanent allowlist
    share [--out FILE]                         write a signed record of counts for the community benchmark (opt-in, nothing is sent)
    week [--model M]                           the last seven days: actions, questions, faults, undos, what is open
    ok [N ...]                                 alone, the open act-then-tell actions; with numbers, the ones you checked count
    excuse [N]                                 alone, the faults of the last 10 minutes; with N, take that one back
    flag --call ID --session ID [--doubt]      a verifier: a fault (or, with --doubt, the next one asks) on one action
    flag N --doubt                             a verifier's doubt on action N: the next action of its kind asks first

simple.explain.title: How tenure decides in simple mode, one kind of action at a time:
simple.explain.free: Free: files, memory, subagents, the usual dev tools, and local commands whose files can be saved first run as with Hermes alone, with an undo where files change.
simple.explain.watched: After a mistake (an undo, a flag, a refusal, a failed automatic check), it keeps acting, but each action of that kind is listed at the end of the turn, with {command}.
simple.explain.ask: After a second mistake, it asks you first: {low} approvals in a row for a low-risk kind, {medium} for a medium-risk one, and it is watched again.
simple.explain.free_again: A watched action you do not undo within {hours} hours counts as fine: {low} in a row without a mistake for a low-risk kind, {medium} for a medium-risk one, and it is free again.
simple.explain.free_again_capped: A watched action you do not undo within {hours} hours counts as fine; a run without a mistake frees it again.
simple.explain.always: Always asks: what reaches outside this machine (push, deploy, publish, upload...), high-risk kinds, kinds your settings make always ask, a script the agent just wrote, a new package, and a file that runs code written after outside content. After outside content, the next command asks once: approved, the conversation works as before (mkdir, git add and git commit never ask).
simple.explain.study: No spot check and no guarantee in this mode. For the study's rule, its guarantee and the signed passport: {command}
simple.ask.suspended: This conversation read outside content, which can carry instructions. Allow this, and commands run as usual for the rest of the conversation. Deny, and they keep asking.
simple.undo.fault_anyway: Counted as a mistake of {type} all the same: you asked to undo it.
